#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Run the wrong original-source review watcher behavioral control once, restoring from a copy."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--source", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path("/home/zech/Projects/.build-worktrees/workspaces/proj-1/task-894-laz-9c889632-34a8-47b8-881f-8ed0a0a57e3c/Build")
scratch = Path("/home/zech/Projects/.agent-scratch/894")
run = scratch / ("review-workspace-source-control-" + args.source[:10])
run.mkdir()
ledger = run / "commands.jsonl"
source = root / "spa/src/core/taskReviewFiles.js"
old = scratch / "review-workspace-wrong-source-before.js"
saved = run / "candidate-taskReviewFiles.js"
node = "/home/zech/.local/share/mise/installs/node/22.23.4/bin/node"
os.environ["PATH"] = str(Path(node).parent) + ":" + os.environ["PATH"]
os.environ["CARGO_BUILD_JOBS"] = "8"
os.environ["TMPDIR"] = str(scratch)

def record(value):
    with ledger.open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value) + "\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())

def command(argv, cwd=root, log=None, expected=0):
    record({"event": "start", "argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd), "log": str(log) if log else None})
    if log:
        with log.open("wb") as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    else:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, check=False)
    record({"event": "complete", "argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd), "exit_code": result.returncode, "expected_exit": expected})
    if expected is not None and result.returncode != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected exit {result.returncode}: {argv}")
    return result

def interrupted(number, _frame):
    raise RuntimeError(f"interrupted by signal {number}; restoring saved source")

for number in [signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM]:
    signal.signal(number, interrupted)

head = command(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]).stdout.decode().strip()
assert head == args.source, (head, args.source)
command(["git", "diff", "--exit-code", "HEAD", "--", "spa/src/core/taskReviewFiles.js", "spa/src/core/directoryWatcher.js", "spa/test/taskReviewFilesHints.test.js"])
assert old.is_file()
command(["/usr/bin/cp", "--preserve=mode,timestamps", "--", str(source), str(saved)])
command(["/usr/bin/cmp", "--", str(source), str(saved)])
record({"event": "source_identity", "head": head,
        "wrong_source_watcher_sha256": hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "saved_candidate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(saved.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
failure = None
restoration = []
negative_exit = None
try:
    command(["/usr/bin/cp", "--", str(old), str(source)])
    command(["/usr/bin/touch", "--", str(source)])
    command(["/usr/bin/cmp", "--", str(old), str(source)])
    log = run / "negative.log"
    result = command(["nice", "-n", "10", node, "node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs", "run",
                      "test/taskReviewFilesHints.test.js", "-t", "ignores original project source hints for a copied workspace directory"],
                     cwd=root / "spa", log=log, expected=1)
    negative_exit = result.returncode
    text = log.read_text()
    assert "FAIL  |unit| test/taskReviewFilesHints.test.js > ignores original project source hints for a copied workspace directory" in text
    assert "actually been called 2 times" in text and '"fs.tree"' in text and '"fs.read"' in text
    record({"event": "behavioral_negative_confirmed", "exit_code": 1,
            "test": "ignores original project source hints for a copied workspace directory", "unrelated_fs_reads": 2})
except BaseException as error:
    failure = repr(error)
finally:
    for argv in [
        ["/usr/bin/cp", "--preserve=mode,timestamps", "--", str(saved), str(source)],
        ["/usr/bin/touch", "--", str(source)],
        ["/usr/bin/cmp", "--", str(saved), str(source)],
        ["git", "diff", "--exit-code", "HEAD", "--", "spa/src/core/taskReviewFiles.js", "spa/src/core/directoryWatcher.js", "spa/test/taskReviewFilesHints.test.js"],
    ]:
        result = command(argv, expected=None)
        if result.returncode:
            restoration.append({"argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode})
    after = command(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], expected=None)
    if after.returncode or after.stdout.decode().strip() != head:
        restoration.append({"source_head_after": after.stdout.decode().strip(), "exit_code": after.returncode})
code = 1 if failure or restoration else 0
summary = {"source": head, "negative_exit_code": negative_exit, "failure": failure,
           "restoration_failures": restoration, "exit_code": code}
record({"event": "restoration_complete", **summary})
(run / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary))
sys.exit(code)
